title: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the world; it's against your own ego. 🔥
paragraphs: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the world; it's against your own ego. 🔥
Pride is a master deceiver. It will convince you that you are "standing strong" while you are actually burning down everything you love. It masks stubbornness as strength and toxicity as loyalty.
Don't let pride be the hill you die on. The armor of God is meant to protect you from the enemy, not to protect you from the truth.
True strength isn't never being wrong; it's having the humility to admit when you are, and surrendering that brokenness to Christ. Drop the shield of pride before it destroys you completely.
📖 "Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall." — Proverbs 16:18 (NIV)
👇 Are you ready to lay down your pride today?
